meta.name: FM Rural Coverage
meta.subtitle: Paper Section IV - 100 MHz long-distance broadcast
meta.description: Reproduces the FM rural-coverage scenario from paper Section IV: a 100 MHz transmitter at low power illuminating an 80x80 passive RIS positioned just past a rural village ~78 km away. The RIS reflects energy back into the village area, lifting the received signal above the -100 dBm sensitivity floor where free-space LOS alone would fail. Propagation runs along the room's length (x-axis).
meta.citation: Paper Section IV - passive RIS for FM broadcast extension
